description: This file defines a DateConverter class used for converting Date objects to Long timestamps and vice versa, facilitating database storage and retrieval with Room.

classes.name: DateConverter
classes.description: A utility class for converting between Date objects and Long timestamps for Room database.

methods.name: fromTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a nullable Long timestamp to a Date object.

methods.name: dateToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a nullable Date object to a Long timestamp.
